fato_historico: 2011: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi is overthrown after the National Transitional Council forces take control of Bab al-Azizia compound during the Libyan Civil War.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a refreshing surge of liberation, Taurus. Just as walls may fall to reveal new horizons, you may find it is a good time to release old burdens that no longer serve your growth. Consider this a golden opportunity to reclaim your personal space and build a foundation rooted in authentic freedom and gentle self-love.
frase_do_dia: True strength blooms when we let go of what holds us back.
significado_numero: Representing the natural rhythm of personal evolution and change.
conselho: Trust your intuition and step confidently into your own expansive new chapter.
